name: New South Wales

population.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Census of Population and Housing 2021

religion.group: Secular Other Spiritual and No Religious Affiliation

ethnicity.note: Australia's census does not ask ethnicity. It asks ancestry and country of birth, plus a separate Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander status question.

sources.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Census of Population and Housing 2021

religion_note: ABS 2021 religious affiliation; the question is voluntary and 'not stated' is retained as its own category.
ancestry_note: ABS ancestry is multi-response (up to two per person), so shares are of responses and sum above 100%.
language_note: ABS 2021 language used at home (G13), one answer per person, at the outermost level of the ABS classification; 'not stated' is retained as its own category.
